name: Stuffed Satchel (Overstuffed, Always Open)
description: A worn leather satchel, slung over one shoulder and perpetually overstuffed with everything Lyrie might need—and a great deal she doesn't. The strap has been tied and re-tied where it snapped. Contents spill out constantly: pressed flowers, lost buttons, half-eaten apples, crumpled notes, a broken comb, and at least three rocks she thought were 'pretty.' The flap never stays closed.
